comparison.objective: Plant a pepper seedling plug and backfill/firm loose potting mix around it; candidate instead separates ceramic media from retained washers through a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2106 requires holding a delicate plug upright while distributing and compacting granular backfill without damaging the plant. Candidate requires bimanual screen grasping, controlled agitation, size-selective aperture passage, washer retention, and support reseating.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2106 grades plug depth/tilt, four-sided soil level, fill, spill, firmness under a push, release, and plant damage. Candidate grades recovered-media mass, complete washer retention, valid hole passage, reseating on two supports, 60 mm release clearance, and a resettable 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate loose bodies and penalize spill, but one tests delicate planting and backfill compaction while the other tests physical size separation through apertures. The detailed rubric versions preserve that substantive distinction.
